title: Continuity of Weighted Dirac Spectra
summary: For the weighted Dirac eigenvalue problem, we show that the two-sided weighted spectrum depends continuously on the weight under continuous deformations within a uniformly elliptic class. Moreover, for differentiable families of weights we obtain a quantitative Lipschitz estimate for the full spectrum in the arsinh--metric, based on a weighted Hellmann--Feynman variational identity.
